title: MCP tools advertise empty inputSchema, so required args are undiscoverable
evidence: src/server.ts:15 maps all 6 tools to inputSchema {type:"object", additionalProperties:true} with no properties/required; src/server.ts:20-22 then mandate args (team_statistics needs team, compare_teams needs teamA/teamB, competition_standings throws 'competition and season are required'). A schema-driven MCP client (or the factual probe) builds args from the schema, gets {}, and the server rejects it with error -32602. _factual.json score 0.0 ('no tool returned a 2019 Serie A table'). This is a genuine artifact defect — the underlying logic is correct (service.standings('Brasileirao',2019) yields Flamengo 38 played / 90 pts / pos 1, 20 clubs) but no MCP client can reach it without guessing arg names.
suggestion: Give each tool a real JSON Schema with properties and a required[] list (e.g. competition_standings: required [competition, season]) so clients can discover and supply mandatory arguments.

title: MCP argument-dispatch path (server.ts) has no test coverage
evidence: test/service.test.ts:7-21 constructs SoccerService and calls service.standings()/findMatches()/players() directly, bypassing server.ts call()/tools/list entirely. The empty-inputSchema defect (F1) shipped precisely because no test exercises the tools/call path. test_coverage=0.9214 (scores.json) — the uncovered ~8% is server.ts.
suggestion: Add a test that drives server.ts over stdio (tools/list then tools/call) and asserts each tool's advertised schema matches the args its handler requires.

title: Repair run fixed the prior standings double-counting defect
evidence: service.ts:21-32 standingsMatches() dedupes overlapping league CSVs (prefers source=='brasileirao', falls back to 'historical'); test/service.test.ts:15-21 asserts the 2019 Serie A table has exactly 20 clubs each with played==38. summary/index.md (pre-repair) still blames standings double-counting — that narrative is now stale.
suggestion: Regenerate summary/index.md so it reflects the repaired standings dedup logic.
